content: AeroSound Pro manual: Pairing: hold the power button for three seconds until the status light flashes blue, then select AeroSound Pro in your device Bluetooth settings. To enable noise cancellation, press the mode button once. Charge with the supplied USB-C cable. Use a soft, dry cloth to clean the ear cups.

TrailWatch 3 manual: For the first GPS fix, go outdoors with a clear view of the sky and start a GPS activity. Rinse the watch with fresh water after exposure to salt water. Do not charge the watch while it is wet.
